revisions.observation: 守护者获得的增益类型被改写为“伤害增加”，既不符合英文 grow in power，也不符合代码实际的移动速度提升。
revisions.evidence: source: "You feel the guardian of this place grow in power." / target: "你感受到这个地方的守护者的伤害增加了。" / fixed_context: "m.movement_speed = m.movement_speed + 0.5 ... English grow in power; code is movement speed"
fixed_context: "English says void shards; code restores Void Stars stacks"；target 用“虚空之星”，与 "Void Stars=虚空之星"、"Essence Reave talent info already 获得 %d 虚空之星" 一致
source: "requires Gestalt to be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown" / target: "需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中"，条件分组一致
fixed_context: "first logPlayer Select the source: then getTarget stored as target ... talent info uses 源生物 and 牺牲生物"；target: "选择源生物:"

revisions.observation: 条件身份被替换：实际失败条件是缺少“异变之手”（getTentacleCombat 为 nil），却译为“空闲的副手”，与另一条独立的副手空手提示混淆。
revisions.evidence: source: "You require a mutated hand!" / target: "你需要空闲的副手！" / fixed_context: "Constrict logs You require a mutated hand! when getTentacleCombat is nil"，且 "separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手"
fixed_context: "Deliberate miss, not dodge"、"talent info already 故意朝目标射出偏离的子弹"；target: "%s故意打偏了%s的射击。"，占位符对应射手名与 his/her
fixed_context: "rejects if self.in_combat or mecharachnid.in_combat or not adjacent/missing"；target: "你需要你的机械蜘蛛与你相邻，并且你必须处于非战斗状态。"

revisions.observation: 感知效果时长存疑：代码为 setEffect(EFF_SENSE, 4)，英文与中文均写 3 回合；无法判断是英文显示串滞后还是此处应保持 3，证据不足以裁定中文。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, {range=rad, actor=1}). English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns." / target: "让你能够在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物"
